notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rabbi Yehudah ben Gadish testifying before Rabbi Eliezer about buying fish brine with second-tithe money. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1634&lang=en) cites the same testimony.
